items.why: Investors kept buying Meta after fresh app data showed its Muse AI assistant posting Day-1 retention rates rivaling ChatGPT, and the Connect showcase pushed Muse into AI glasses and new hardware.
Profit-taking after a record run, with chips under fresh pressure after the sector's worst week in a month. CNBC noted Micron leading tech lower as AI spending doubts linger.
Crude jumped after Houthi rebels struck Saudi targets over the weekend and Russia kept hitting Ukrainian energy sites despite Trump's announced energy ceasefire.
Volatility ticked up as equities traded mixed, with the Dow gaining while the Nasdaq slipped under falling chip stocks and rising crude.

market_note: S&P futures flat, Nasdaq futures down 0.7%, Dow futures up 0.4%.
summary: Stocks are mixed to start the week, with the Dow gaining while the Nasdaq slips as chip stocks keep sliding and crude oil jumps. Big bank earnings kick off tomorrow, with inflation data due Wednesday.
